newsitem.title: USA: Wholesale prices fall 0.1 percent in March.
newsitem.headline: Wholesale prices fall 0.1 percent in March.

text.p: Prices at the wholesale level fell for the third month in a row in March, the Labor Department said Friday, new evidence that fears of a major breakout of inflation may as yet be unfounded.
The department said the Producer Price Index fell 0.1 percent after dropping 0.4 percent in February and 0.3 percent percent in January.
